name: EventScope Results Agent
description: Reads each event's official public source (ESPN scoreboards, Coinbase Exchange candles, Open-Meteo), posts the result to the EventScope pot with the SHA-256 of the source response, waits out the dispute window, finalizes and pays winners. Owned by the EventScope operator account. Testnet demo.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

skills.name: Post results with evidence
skills.description: proposeResult(event, outcome, sha256(source), source_url) then finalize and payout.
